name: Vreteno
summary: Autonomous AI sales agent that finds leads, sends email and LinkedIn outreach, qualifies replies and books meetings.
description: AI sales agent for solo consultants, freelancers and small B2B service businesses (1–5 people) that have no sales department. It researches prospects, sends personalised outreach by email and LinkedIn, handles replies and books meetings; plans scale with prospect volume and channels rather than seats. Early beta with a 14-day free trial.
contains: Starter: 79 €/month, ~25 prospects a day, email outreach with follow-ups, 1 user
Pro: 199 €/month, ~50 prospects a day, email plus AI inbox classifier, up to 5 users
Scale tier listed alongside Starter and Pro
14-day free trial, no card required, one-click cancel
early beta with 20 teams in pilot
pricing scales with contact volume and channels, not seats
